description: Flugziele am Flughafen Stuttgart is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Baden-Württemberg. Vom Flughafen Stuttgart angeflogene Ziele nach Staat. Enthalten sind Anzahl der Flüge, Fracht und Post an Bord sowie Passagiere an Bord. Die Daten werden vom Statistischen Bundesamt bereitgestellt und jährlich aktualisiert. Coverage: Open Data Baden-Württemberg. The portal files it under the publisher Open Data Baden-Württemberg. Its tags are flughafen, flugziele, flüge, luftfracht, luftverkehr. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
